project_overview: NIVARA - A sensitive AI-powered support platform for victims of harassment/distress. The app features three distinct role-based interfaces with vastly different visual languages.

global_typography.instructions: Do not use standard generic fonts like Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings. Use the specific font pairings listed for each role.

victim.name: Victim Interface - Immersive Companion
victim.emotion: Safe, calm, grounded, private, not overwhelming.

layout_guidelines.structure: Immersive companion layout. Central focus. NOT a dashboard. No sidebars.
layout_guidelines.components: Big soft glowing AI voice orb, large prominent 'I NEED IMMEDIATE HELP' button, floating bottom actions.
layout_guidelines.spacing: Generous, breathable. Use p-8 to p-12. Avoid clutter.

victim.visual_enhancers: Soft glowing shadows for the orb, glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/60) for floating UI elements to maintain background visibility.

image_urls.background_description: Soft glowing abstract purple/pink waves to create a calming, ambient environment.

officer.name: Officer Interface - Live Response Center

layout_guidelines.structure: Dense bento grid layout. Map taking up significant central space.
layout_guidelines.components: Real-time feed sidebars, map overlays, compact data tables.
layout_guidelines.spacing: Tight and compact to maximize information density. Use p-4 to p-6, gap-4.

officer.visual_enhancers: Grid borders (1px solid strokes instead of soft shadows), retro-futurism technical touches (sharp corners, high contrast status indicators).

counsellor.name: Counsellor Interface - Case Journey

typography.heading: Playfair Display
typography.rationale: Warm, narrative, empathetic and easy to read for long form notes.

layout_guidelines.components: Soft cards for notes, clear progression trackers, spacious form fields.
layout_guidelines.spacing: Wide, comfortable, airy. Use p-6 to p-10.

counsellor.visual_enhancers: Neumorphism (tactile) subtle ambient shadows, rounded corners, soft borders.

image_urls.header_texture_description: Warm yellow and orange sun abstract for a welcoming header.

SVI_Badge.instruction: Ensure this badge component is reusable across both the Officer and Counsellor interfaces, adapting slightly if needed for light/dark mode legibility.

Map.instruction: Use Leaflet for the interactive map in the Officer dashboard. Ensure the map theme matches the dark tactical UI (use a dark tile layer like CartoDB Dark Matter).

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Do not use fully transparent backgrounds under headers or overlays where text visibility could be compromised. Use glassmorphism or solid colors.
All interactive elements and key information MUST have a data-testid attribute.

Prioritize Shadcn/ui components for complex interactive logic, but completely override their styling (Tailwind classes) when rendering the Victim or Counsellor interfaces to avoid the generic SaaS look.
Build distinct Layout wrapper components (e.g., VictimLayout, OfficerLayout, CounsellorLayout) to enforce the radically different visual structures.
Implement WebSocket or mock intervals for real-time alerts on the Officer interface.
Use Framer Motion for the glowing AI orb in the Victim interface and page transitions.
